description: This PHP class defines the social commitment model for the Goteo project, including methods for retrieving, saving, and managing social commitment data, as well as related categories and icon handling.

classes.name: SocialCommitment
classes.description: Model class for social commitments, managing CRUD operations, localized fields, related categories, and icon assets.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the fields used for localization: name and description.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a social commitment record by its ID, optionally in a specified language.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all social commitments, with optional filters and language settings.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon image for the social commitment, optionally forcing asset retrieval.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the social commitment, accepting an Image object or icon path.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches category IDs associated with a specific social commitment.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current social commitment object to the database, performing validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the social commitment data, ensuring required fields are filled.
